results.description:
DayCount helps you stay aware of time and the moments that matter.

You can count towards what's coming up, keep track of time since important moments, and set reminders that work around your events. Everything stays clear and easy to manage, whatever you're using it for.

---

Key Features

Event Counters
- Countdown using event counters that track time before and after your date
- Group events using custom categories
- Apply images from your device or search Unsplash
- Arrange events alphabetically or by date
- Repeat events daily, weekly, fortnightly, monthly, yearly, or at custom intervals
- Write notes in dedicated spaces for each event
- Decimal counting for precise measurements

Streaks and Habits
- Build positive habits by tracking daily streaks
- Work towards your longest run of productive days
- View streaks alongside your events

Widgets
- Create widgets using different filters, fonts, textures, and borders
- Add widgets to your Home Screen or Lock Screen

Reminders
- Set alerts minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, or years before or after events
- Daily summary notifications showing your top 5 events or streaks

Appearance and Accessibility
- Event size options from regular to huge
- Higher contrast options for improved text readability
- Support for Dynamic Type
- Light and Dark modes
- Alternate app icons

Sharing and Integrations
- Share full-resolution screenshots of your events
- Import events directly from your calendar
- Save a location to an event and open directions in Apple Maps or Google Maps

Privacy and Security
- Backup and sync events and streaks across iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, and Mac
- Lock the app using Face ID or Touch ID
- Manual time zone control

---

Subscription Information

DayCount offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription with a free 7-day trial.

After the free trial ends, payment will be charged to your iTunes account. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period at the same price.

You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Account Settings.

DayCount Premium is available as an annual subscription or a lifetime purchase.

---

results.description:
Countdown is a free, easy-to-use countdown and reminder app for all of life's big events.

Your next vacation, birthday, wedding, concert, graduation or retirement is always one glance away. Create unlimited events and make each one your own.

Downloaded over 20 million times. It's been a joy to shape Countdown with your feedback for more than eight years. We're looking forward to many more.

——— WIDGETS & APPLE WATCH ———
• See your next event with free circular and inline Lock Screen widgets
• Show one event or a list of upcoming events in Home Screen widgets, and filter lists by tag or pinned events (Premium)
• Show your event's emoji, title and time left in the rectangular Lock Screen widget, and keep countdowns visible in StandBy (Premium)
• Check your countdowns on Apple Watch and add them to your watch face

——— REMINDERS & ALARMS ———
• Get a reminder on the big day and the day before, at a time you set
• Add custom reminders minutes, hours, days, weeks or months in advance (Premium)
• Set alarms that ring even when your iPhone is on silent (Premium; requires iOS 26.1 or later)

——— MAKE IT YOURS ———
• Pick an emoji and a color for every countdown, and add notes
• Make events repeat every day, week, month or year, or on your own schedule, like every two weeks or the last Friday of the month
• See the age someone turns on their birthday and the years celebrated on an anniversary
• Add holidays and big events in one tap from suggestions for your country
• Count only weekdays, or see the time since a past event
• Choose how you see the time left, with units from years to seconds (Premium)

——— STAY ORGANIZED ———
• Group events with tags and pin your favorites to the top
• Archive events once they pass, so your list shows what's next
• Archive or delete past events automatically (Premium)
• Sort by date or drag events into your own order
• Search for events, duplicate them and edit several at once

——— SYNC, IMPORT & SHARE ———
• Your events stay up to date on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with iCloud
• Bring in events from your calendars and birthdays from your contacts
• Automatically turn new calendar events into countdowns with Auto Import (Premium)
• Add your countdowns to your calendar
• Send a link so friends and family can count down with you
• Check countdowns with Siri and create them with Shortcuts

——— YOUR PRIVACY ———
Your plans are personal. We never use your countdowns for advertising, and our analytics never see the titles, dates or notes you enter.

——— PREMIUM ———
One purchase. No subscriptions.
Unlock all widgets, custom reminders, alarms, Auto Import, every countdown format and more. Premium also removes ads.

——— QUESTIONS OR FEEDBACK? ———
We love hearing from you and read every email.
Get in touch at countdown@findappiness.co

results.description:
EVERYTHING YOU ARE WAITING FOR - IN A WIDGET

Design your own personalized countdown or count-up widgets for your home screen & lock screen.  
Countdown Widget is a super fun way to track the days until a momentous occasion such as:

- Your birthday, or another special someone’s birthday
- A long-awaited vacation
- Back to school
- Upcoming elections
- A returning season of your favorite TV series
- A favorite yearly tech event
- A new video game is up for preorder
Or any other future event!

Countdown Widget makes waiting for something exciting even more thrilling by giving you a cool and colorful visual reminder on your home screen. Use it to count down to a big event, to mark the end of something less fun, or to keep track of work deadlines (weekend exclusion is now possible!) - it's a super fun way to stay on top of things!

COUNT UP
Create a count-up widget to mark a significant moment in time and track the duration since it occurred.

CREATE A PERSONALIZED COUNTDOWN WIDGET
Create a Widget with your custom design in a matter of seconds.
You can choose from 11 Countdown styles (we are already working on more) and make them your own by adding your personal touch:

- Change background colors.
- Use photos from your phone Photo Library or from our preset gallery.
- Choose from a curated list of fonts that go well with each specific style.
- Each Widget you make will automatically be available in small or medium sizes.
- Change the design anytime later.

WE WOULD LOVE YOUR FEEDBACK
As a small team, we are excited to have our first app on the App Store. We value your feedback and would love to hear from you if you have any questions, suggestions, or anything else you think we should know. Don't hesitate to get in touch with us at - hi@taptics.co.

Note:
The Free version of the app includes one countdown widget with the basic design.

results.description:
Countdown Star is the best way to countdown to — and count up from — all of your favorite events.

Countdown to birthdays, holidays, an upcoming vacation, a wedding, the New Year, parties, sporting events, concerts and more.
Count up from anniversaries, the day you were born, and other special events in the past.

* How many seconds until your next birthday?
* How many months since you were born?
* How many days until you graduate from college?
* How many hours until your anniversary?
* How much time is left until your vacation starts?
* How many days until Christmas?
* How many minutes until your party begins?
* How much time is left until your baby's due date?

Countdown Star is the countdown app that lets you choose which events to add, then keeps them in sync across all of your devices.

Features:

* iCloud Sync — events and wallpapers sync automatically across all your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch devices
* Celebration Animations — choose Confetti, Fireworks, Balloons, Stars, or Lasers when your countdown reaches zero
* Repeating Events — annual events automatically advance to the next year so you never have to update them
* Home Screen Widgets — Small, Medium, and Large widgets let you glance at your countdowns without opening the app
* Apple Watch — view your events right on your wrist
* Add Your Own Events — add as many events as you like
* Custom Wallpapers — choose from 15+ built-in wallpapers or use your own photos
* Time Zone Support — set each event in any time zone with localized city names
* Sort and Search — sort by date, title, or your own custom order; events are sectioned into Countdown and Count Up groups
* Favorites and Notifications — mark events as favorites to receive a notification when their countdown reaches zero
* Interactive Slider — instantly switch between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, or years to see your countdown exactly how you want it
* Customizable Timer — choose timer position (Top, Middle, or Bottom), show or hide weeks, and toggle the leading zero
* Multiple App Icons — personalize the app icon on your Home Screen

Note: Countdown Star is available as a free version (with ads and an optional Remove Ads purchase) and as a paid ad-free version.

results.description:
A countdown that never loses your days — and never holds its four widgets back.

Add the day that matters, put it on your home screen, and watch it come closer. No limit on how many you keep, and nothing between you and the number.

FOUR WIDGETS, FREE
• Four widgets: one countdown, the next few in a list, a spotlight, or a tile for each
• Every size of all four, on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen
• Unlimited events — there is no cap, and there never will be
• Count down to a date, or count up from one
• Recurring events: yearly, monthly, weekly, or every few days
• Reminders on the day, and as far ahead as you want
• iCloud sync, with no account to make
• Import from a calendar, a spreadsheet, or another countdown app — and export any time
• No ads, ever

COUNT DOWN TO ANYTHING
A wedding countdown, a vacation or trip countdown, a birthday or an anniversary. Christmas, New Year, Halloween and Thanksgiving. Exam day, graduation, retirement, a baby due date, a concert, a deadline, payday. Or count the days since a day that has already happened.

YOUR DAYS, KEPT
Most countdown apps lose your events at the worst moment — an update, a reinstall, a phone that died. This one takes a snapshot of everything on this device every single day, and always before anything risky. Thirty days of history, one tap to restore, and nothing ever leaves your phone. Days that have already passed are never deleted either: they collect into a timeline you can look back through, with the longest wait of each year written next to it.

THE MOMENT ITSELF
When a countdown reaches a milestone — a hundred days, a week, the morning of — the app opens on the number, full screen, and gives you a card worth sharing.

THE BACK OF EVERY EVENT
Tap an event and it turns over to a page of its own. Write a few lines, add photos, record a voice — the story of the day, kept with the day. It syncs with iCloud, goes into every backup, and shares as one picture.

MADE TO LOOK LIKE YOURS
Thirty-six ready-made events, from a birthday to a first day at work, each already set up with the right repeat and the right reminders. Two hundred drawn icons and the whole emoji keyboard. A hundred and fifty-nine full-screen backdrops — twenty-two of them photographs — a hundred and seven in Pro.

COUNTDOWN PRO
Pro unlocks the Pro backdrops, with a new drop every month, your own photos behind a countdown, Photo Roll — a widget that turns your event's own photos over behind the count, the Pro typefaces, the Lock Screen Live Activity, and inviting someone to count down with you. Whatever you unlock while subscribed stays yours for good — cancelling only stops the new ones arriving. Your countdowns, reminders and the four widgets work the same whether you subscribe or not.

———

Countdown Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Prices for the annual plan, which includes a 7-day free trial, and the monthly plan are shown in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends, and you can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings at any time. A one-time Lifetime purchase is also available; it does not renew.

Privacy Policy: https://dyljqq.github.io/countdown/privacy-policy/

Ready for iOS 27, with a bigger widget and a couple of visual fixes. Upcoming Events, the widget that used to be called Next 4 Events, now comes in the new extra-large size and shows up to eight events. It works at extra-large on iPad too.
